ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Wassiya uses Face ID to unlock your vault key on this device.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wassiya uses the camera to photograph your documents and scan QR codes. Everything is encrypted on your device.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wassiya uses the microphone to record your voice notes. The recording is encrypted on your device before it is saved.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech is recognised on your device to dictate your notes. Your voice is never sent to a server.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wassiya uses your photos so you can choose what to keep in your vault. Everything is encrypted on your device.
